name: Inhibrx Biosciences, Inc.

profile.description: Inhibrx Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotech developing ozekibart (INBRX-109, a DR5 agonist) and INBRX-106 for oncology. It reported no revenue in H1 2026, a Q2 net loss of $36.7M (-$2.34 EPS) and R&D of $23.9M, and trades at about $94 with a $1.4B market cap.

innovation.label: DEVELOPING
innovation.analysis: Track record 2: spin-out and restructuring after Sanofi acquired INBRX-101, refocusing on ozekibart [1][2]. Pipeline 1: pivotal ozekibart and INBRX-106 data reported but approval timelines unquantified [1]. R&D 1: Q2 R&D of $23.9M against zero revenue is top-tier intensity; no AI deployment or market share evidence (0).

inspiration.label: DEVELOPING
inspiration.analysis: Mission floor 2: clear oncology-for-patients focus without a distinctive deeper purpose [2]. Insider buying 2: CEO Mark Lappe bought 10,000 shares in late September 2026 (roughly $950K) and a prior $998K buy [2]. Retention 1: founding scientists stayed about 15 years, though co-founder CSO Brendan Eckelman departed in 2025 [2]; no community data.

infrastructure.label: WEAK
infrastructure.analysis: Mechanical score 0: ROE -1774% (2x weight) and profit margin 0% both score 0.0; D/E, revenue growth and forward P/E unavailable or negative and excluded.

ai_resilience.label: MODERATE
ai_resilience.analysis: Drug development rests on clinical trials and FDA approval, which AI cannot substitute; AI-aided discovery may speed rivals but does not displace an advanced-stage asset [1]. No analyst commentary on AI threat to INBX found; no AI revenue.

infinite_game.summary: Single-asset-dependent biotech with long scientific tenure and a recent leadership reshuffle; purpose is patient-focused but unproven at commercial scale.

just_cause.analysis: Distinctive commitment to developing differentiated biologics for cancer patients, consistently pursued since the original Inhibrx founding, though not yet tested at commercial scale [2].

trusting_teams.analysis: Adequate: 15-year scientific continuity but a 2025 CSO/President reshuffle after co-founder departure [2].

worthy_rivals.analysis: No evidence of explicit worthy-rival framing.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Restructured from a multi-asset private company to a focused public ozekibart company; evolutionary rather than transformative [2].

courage_to_lead.analysis: Spin-out structure and selling INBRX-101 to Sanofi funded focus on ozekibart; burning $70M in H1 2026 on clinical trials is a long-term bet [1][2].

investment_thesis: Ozekibart delivered pivotal data in 2026 and INBRX-106 has reported results, with insiders buying about $950K in September [1][2]. A $1.4B market cap on a de-risked pivotal asset gives binary upside on a regulatory filing.
thesis_continued: The company has zero revenue, lost $70.1M in H1 2026 and trades at about 20x annual burn in market cap [1]. ROE is deeply negative, there is no profit, and the mechanical Infrastructure score is 0 as ROE and margin both floor out; a trial or FDA setback could cut the stock sharply.
key_catalysts: Ozekibart regulatory submission and FDA feedback
Partnering or financing at favorable valuation
key_risks: Leadership turnover after co-founder CSO exit
